title: FBI Photo B012
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white video or surveillance camera still with overlay graphics
pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or surveillance camera feed. A white crosshair reticle is centered, with a horizontal scale marked 15, 10, 5, 0, 5, 10, 15 and tick marks extending from a central vertical axis. A small dark dot appears in the upper-middle area near the crosshair. Faint mountainous terrain is visible in the lower right portion of the frame. Multiple solid black rectangular bars (apparent redactions) are scattered across the image at various positions. A white timestamp reads '12/31/99 18:11:12' in the lower left corner. A large black bar spans the top of the frame.
